draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.67, the 227th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 20th of 25 at LB. He went 225th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 91 tackles in 2021, 12th of 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 46 career games and 4 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile), combined tackles 5 (6th percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 off-ball linebacker who played: 5 combined tackles against a median of 40, below the norm.
